title: Grusch says he knows John Harrington

tellings.quote: I said, "Have you ever heard of John Harrington?" And Grush said, "Oh, I know I know John Harrington."

plain: In 2023, at his house in Los Angeles, the television writer and producer Bryce Zabel says he asked David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who told Congress about hidden UFO programmes, whether he had heard of John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy. Zabel tells Michels that Grusch answered, "Oh, I know John Harrington," and he mentions the journalist Ross Coulthart in telling it. The point is that the man Zabel's circle connected to an alien story was already known to the people pushing for disclosure.
